**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
The Sr. Manager, Data Science - Operations serves as the strategic and technical leader responsible for driving data science, AI, optimization, and advanced analytics initiatives across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and Product Formulation functions. This role partners closely with business and technology leaders to identify opportunities, develop scalable analytical solutions, and translate complex business challenges into measurable operational and financial outcomes. Success in this role is demonstrated through delivering enterprise-wide value, accelerating data-driven decision making, and advancing Kraft Heinz's digital transformation agenda.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the identification, prioritization, and execution of advanced analytics, machine learning, optimization, and AI initiatives across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and Formulation functions.
* Partner with business stakeholders and operational leaders to understand strategic objectives, define analytical roadmaps, and translate business requirements into scalable data science solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analytics professionals, and cross-functional project teams without direct people management responsibilities.
* Communicate analytical insights, recommendations, business cases, and project outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders using clear, concise, and business-friendly language.
* Design and oversee development of predictive, prescriptive, and optimization models that improve operational efficiency, forecasting accuracy, inventory management, production planning, and product development processes.
* Champion best practices in data science, AI, model governance, experimentation, and responsible AI across the organization.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and innovative analytical approaches to continuously improve business capabilities and competitive advantage.

**Requirements**

* Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or Statistics
* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Data Science, Analytics, Operations Research, Machine Learning, or Advanced Analytics
* Demonstrated experience supporting Manufacturing, Digital Twin, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Production Planning, Inventory Optimization, Procurement, or Product Formulation functions
* Proven track record delivering business value through predictive analytics, optimization, simulation, statistical modeling, and AI solutions.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving business stakeholders, technology teams, and executive leadership.
* Experience translating ambiguous business challenges into analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations.
* Preferred experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG), Food & Beverage, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Operations environments.
* Experience with cloud-based analytical platforms and modern data ecosystems.

Location(s)
  
  
Bengaluru - Brookfield GCC
  
  
**Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes.**

jobs.description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**
**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.**
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**
**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**
**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
**Position Description:**

* As a Research Scientist on the Biopharma Technical Development (BTD) Analytical Development team, you are responsible for providing scientific and technical leadership for analytical activities across Elanco’s biotechnology therapeutics programs. This role has a particular focus on technical transfer activities and oversight of analytical method-related work at internal and external partners, including 3rd party CDMOs. The incumbent is expected to work as an integrated member of cross-functional project teams and partner closely with Analytical Development (AD) and Process Development (PD) subject matter experts to build a strong understanding of the product, process, control strategy, and analytical methods supporting the program.
* The individual will apply this technical knowledge and experience to support successful analytical method transfer, qualification, validation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management activities. This includes working extensively with sending site and receiving site SMEs to ensure on-time delivery, high-fidelity transfer execution, and effective resolution of technical issues and risks. The role will collaborate closely with biopharma CMC teams, technical project leads, quality, regulatory, and senior leadership to ensure clear, concise, and timely communication of project activities, milestones, gaps, and mitigation plans.
* Overall, the Research Scientist will serve an essential function in bridging internal analytical development teams with both internal and external manufacturing partners, ensuring analytical readiness and successful support of clinical and commercial supply, registration activities, and broader program execution.

**Functions, Duties, Tasks:**

* Oversee all aspects of analytical method transfer activities for biopharmaceutical products to internal and/or external laboratories, CROs, and CDMOs.
* Serve as an embedded analytical representative within project teams, working closely with AD and PD SMEs to develop a deep technical understanding of the process, product, and analytical methods before and during transfer activities.
* Provide technical oversight across the analytical method lifecycle, including method transfer, qualification, validation, troubleshooting, and ongoing lifecycle support for biologics programs.
* Partner with sending and receiving site SMEs to prepare, execute, monitor, and close out analytical transfers, ensuring alignment on scope, readiness, acceptance criteria, and technical expectations.
* Manage technical relationships and project deliverables with external vendors, CROs, and CDMOs, ensuring timely execution of agreed activities and rapid escalation of technical risks, gaps, and issues.
* Evaluate analytical data, transfer outcomes, deviations, and method performance trends to identify technical risks and drive appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Author, review, and edit technical documents, protocols, reports, method transfer packages, and supporting regulatory or quality documentation, ensuring compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Research Practice (GRP), and other applicable quality and regulatory requirements.
* Communicate regularly with technical teams, project leads, and senior leadership regarding project progress, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Collaborate with QA and Regulatory partners to ensure analytical activities and documentation meet internal expectations and global quality standards.
* Support analytical readiness for clinical trial supply, process performance qualification/validation activities, registration, and commercial supply as applicable to the program stage.
* Travel to sending and/or receiving sites as needed to support successful analytical transfer execution, technical alignment, and timely issue resolution.

**Minimum Qualification (education, experience and/or training, required certifications):**

* Education: Ph.D. in biology, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a related field with a minimum of 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry; or M.S. in a related field with a minimum of 4 years of experience; or B.S. in a related field with a minimum of 8 years of experience.
* Required Experience: Demonstrated experience supporting the analytical method lifecycle for biologics, including method transfer, qualification, validation, and technical troubleshooting in a regulated environment. Experience working with external vendors, CROs, and/or CDMOs is required.
* Technical Know-How: Strong scientific understanding of analytical methods used to support biologic products and the ability to quickly build working knowledge of product and process attributes relevant to method performance and transfer success. Must be able to partner effectively with AD and PD SMEs to translate technical understanding into robust transfer strategy and execution.
* Top Skills: Demonstrated experience with analytical methods for biologics (e.g., monoclonal antibodies, vaccines) using techniques such as HPLC, CE, and ELISA; strong technical writing and document review skills; ability to manage cross-functional and external technical relationships; strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Additional Preferences:**

* Thorough understanding of GMP/GRP requirements and quality systems, with experience applying them from early-phase through late-phase development.
* Experience with statistical approaches to experimental design (DoE) and the ability to analyze, interpret, and document complex data.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and contribute to technical risk assessments or root cause investigations.

A collaborative mindset with experience fostering connections and sharing best practices across global teams and external partners.
  
  
Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status
  
  
Elanco may use automated tools, including AI, to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications against job‑related criteria and/or transferrable skills. These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. For more information on how we handle personal data, please see our Elanco Workforce Privacy Notice.

* **Growth:**
  Opportunity to work on innovative skincare products from concept to launch while collaborating directly with leadership and cross-functional teams.

  Fast-paced, collaborative, science-driven, and ownership-focused environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a CMF Designer to own and develop the Color, Material & Finish direction across a range of physical products.

You will work closely with Product Design, NPD, Sourcing, and Manufacturing teams to translate design concepts into products that are visually distinctive, tactilely engaging, commercially viable, and manufacturable at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop CMF concepts and directions for new and existing products.
* Define color palettes, materials, textures, surface treatments, and finishes.
* Create CMF boards, material libraries, color standards, and product specifications.
* Work closely with product and industrial designers to integrate CMF into product concepts.
* Research new materials, finishes, textures, manufacturing techniques, and design trends.
* Evaluate materials and finishes based on aesthetics, functionality, durability, cost, and manufacturability.
* Work with vendors and manufacturers to develop and refine samples.
* Review prototypes and production samples and ensure they match the intended design.
* Drive color matching and finish consistency across products and production batches.
* Work with sourcing and manufacturing teams on material availability, costing, MOQ, and production constraints.
* Support NPD from concept development through sampling and final production.
* Build and maintain a structured CMF library.
* Ensure consistency of visual and tactile language across different product categories.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2–5 years of experience in CMF, industrial design, product design, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of colors, materials, textures, finishes, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience taking CMF concepts from concept → sampling → production.
* Strong visual sense and attention to detail.
* Hands-on experience working with manufacturers and vendors.
* Understanding of materials such as plastics, metals, fabrics, silicone, coatings, paints, etc.
* Ability to balance aesthetics with functionality, cost, durability, and manufacturability.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in consumer products, lifestyle products, toys, furniture, consumer electronics, footwear, or other physical products.
* Knowledge of injection moulding, blow moulding, vacuum forming, powder coating, anodising, printing, textiles, or other manufacturing processes.
* Experience working directly with factories and vendors.
* A strong portfolio showcasing CMF thinking and real-world product development.

**ABOUT US**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond-based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**JOB IN SUMMARY**

The Regional Food Safety Microbiologist for Asia Pacific will provide advanced scientific leadership and technical expertise in food microbiology, microbiological risk management, environmental monitoring, validation science and food safety systems.

The role will support the implementation of global food safety strategies and initiatives across Asia Pacific while ensuring effective deployment of microbiological control programs, environmental monitoring systems, validation programs and risk management practices. The position will support ofi's Zero Incident Mindset through the application of sound science, robust risk assessments and continuous improvement of food safety controls.

As part of the Global Food Safety COE, the role will work closely with regional Quality & Food Safety teams, site leadership, Operations, Engineering and global food safety experts to drive harmonization, capability building and consistent application of food safety standards across all product platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Global Food Safety COE Deployment**

* Act as the Asia Pacific representative of the Global Food Safety COE.
* Support implementation of global food safety strategies, standards and initiatives across all Asia Pacific sites.
* Drive alignment and harmonization of microbiological risk management programs across regions.
* Support continuous improvement of global food safety standards and governance processes.
* Participate in global communities of practice and technical working groups.

**Microbiological Risk Management**

* Serve as the regional subject matter expert for food microbiology and microbiological risk management.
* Lead microbiological risk assessments for products, ingredients, processes and manufacturing environments.
* Identify current and emerging microbiological risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Support the development of preventive food safety controls using scientific and risk-based approaches.
* Provide technical leadership during significant food safety incidents and investigations.

**Environmental Monitoring Programs**

* Lead deployment and continuous improvement of environmental monitoring programs across Asia Pacific.
* Establish risk-based pathogen and indicator organism monitoring strategies.
* Support sites in trend analysis, program optimization and investigation of environmental positives.
* Drive standardization of environmental monitoring methodologies across the region.
* Provide technical guidance for environmental monitoring program design and governance.

**Thermal Process Validation Program**

* Own and lead the validation program for thermal kill steps across all relevant manufacturing sites within Asia Pacific.
* Develop validation standards, protocols and scientific methodologies aligned with global requirements.
* Review and approve thermal process validation studies and challenge testing activities.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering teams to ensure validated processes are maintained and controlled.
* Support revalidation following process, product or equipment changes.
* Drive consistency of thermal process validation approaches across product platforms and regions.
* Maintain oversight of thermal validation effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Validation & Verification**

* Provide technical leadership for food safety validation and verification programs.
* Support validation of preventive controls, sanitation programs and microbiological interventions.
* Review validation protocols and ensure scientific rigor in study design and interpretation.
* Support implementation of risk-based verification activities across manufacturing sites.
* Ensure effective documentation and governance of validation programs.

**Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead microbiological investigations associated with food safety incidents, environmental positives and customer complaints.
* Support root cause investigations and development of corrective and preventive actions.
* Review regional microbiological trends and identify recurring issues requiring systematic improvement.
* Provide guidance during product disposition decisions and crisis management activities.

**Capability Building & Training**

* Develop and deliver advanced food microbiology and food safety training programs.
* Build microbiological capability across regional and site Quality & Food Safety teams.
* Coach and mentor food safety professionals across the region.
* Support development of technical competency frameworks for food safety and microbiology disciplines.
* Drive knowledge sharing through communities of practice and technical forums.

* Review new test methods and support implementation at all Micro Labs.

**Regulatory, Customer & Audit Support**

* Participate in customer specifications review, understand requirements for RTE products, and provide guidance to sites on implementation.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATION**

* Advanced expertise in foodborne pathogens, environmental microbiology, thermal processing and microbiological risk assessment.

jobs.title: AGM - Quality Control
jobs.description:
Job Title: Assistant General Manager (AGM) – Quality Control (QC)  
Department: Quality Control  
Industry: Pharmaceuticals – API / Bulk Drug Manufacturing  
Reports To: Head of Quality / Site Quality Head / VP – Quality  
Job Purpose:  
To lead and manage overall Quality Control laboratory operations—covering raw material, in-process, intermediate, finished API, and stability testing—while ensuring 100% compliance with cGMP, GLP, Data Integrity (ALCOA+), and global regulatory standards (USFDA, EDQM, WHO, CDSCO).  
Key Responsibilities:

* Laboratory Operations: Direct end-to-end sampling, analytical testing, and timely release of Raw Materials (RM), Packing Materials (PM), In-Process samples, Intermediates, Finished APIs, and Water/Environment monitoring samples to meet production and dispatch schedules.
* Instrumentation & Calibration: Ensure timely qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration, and preventive maintenance of analytical instruments including HPLC, GC, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS, ICP-OES, XRD, FTIR, UV, and Karl Fischer.
* Stability Management: Oversee the stability program (charging, pulling, testing, and trend evaluation) in accordance with ICH guidelines and regulatory filing commitments.
* Regulatory Audits & Compliance: Serve as the primary auditee for QC during regulatory inspections (USFDA, MHRA, EU-GMP, TGA, PMDA, WHO) and customer audits, ensuring continuous audit readiness.
* Data Integrity & Computerized Systems: Enforce strict compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles across all standalone instruments, CDS (Empower/Chromeleon), and LIMS; oversee periodic audit trail reviews.
* QMS & Investigations: Lead root-cause investigations for Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and laboratory incidents; review and approve Deviations, Change Controls, and CAPAs.
* Method Transfer & Validation: Oversee Analytical Method Validation (AMV), Method Verification, and Analytical Method Transfer (AMT) from R&D/ADL to commercial QC.
* Documentation Control: Review and approve QC SOPs, Specifications, Standard Testing Procedures (STPs), and Certificates of Analysis (CoAs).
* Standards & Inventory Management: Manage qualification, storage, and inventory of reference/working standards, impurities, columns, and reagents.
* Team Leadership & Budgeting: Lead, mentor, and manage shift schedules for QC Managers and Analysts; prepare annual Capex/Opex budgets and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.

Qualifications & Experience:

* Education: M.Sc. (Chemistry / Analytical Chemistry / Organic Chemistry) or M.Pharm.
* Experience: 15–20+ years in Pharmaceutical Quality Control, with extensive experience in API / Bulk Drug manufacturing and at least 4–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Regulatory Exposure: Proven track record of successfully handling stringent regulatory audits (USFDA, EDQM, EU-GMP, etc.).

Key Skills & Competencies:

* Expertise in chromatography (HPLC, GC), spectroscopy, and trace-level impurity analysis (nitrosamines, genotoxic impurities, elemental impurities).
* Thorough knowledge of ICH guidelines (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q7) and major pharmacopeias (USP, EP, BP, IP).
* Strong analytical troubleshooting, crisis management, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Pay: ₹1,100,000.00 - ₹1,900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided

We work with diverse value chains including cereals, millets, oilseeds, spices, dairy, poultry, horticulture, and post-harvest systems to improve productivity, diversify farm incomes, reduce drudgery, and strengthen climate resilience. **Organisation:** GCV Life Pvt. Ltd. (GCViDEAL)**Job Title:** Executive/ Manager - Product Development & Commercialisation

**Job type:** On site

**Location:** Chakala, Mumbai

**About the Role**

Responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end product development, formulation development, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and supply-chain activities for nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, personal care and allied product categories.

The role involves translating client requirements and market opportunities into commercially viable products through coordination with contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, internal business development teams and quality/regulatory functions.

**Key Responsibilities**A. Product Development & NPD

· Manage the product development lifecycle from initial concept and client requirement assessment to formulation finalisation, sampling, validation and commercial manufacturing.

· Evaluate new product opportunities based on market trends, consumer requirements, ingredient innovations and commercial feasibility.

· Coordinate with contract manufacturers and technical teams for new product development across nutraceutical, functional food, pharmaceutical and personal care categories.

· Drive formulation development, optimisation and improvement in terms of ingredient selection, active concentrations, excipient systems, flavour profiles, stability and product performance.

· Evaluate innovative delivery formats, including gummies, powders, sachets, tablets, capsules, liquids, RTDs and other functional formats.

· Coordinate prototype development, sample evaluation, sensory assessment and subsequent formulation modifications.

· Prepare and manage New Product Development (NPD/NPDP) documentation and development timelines.

· Coordinate technical feasibility assessments for new ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and product formats.

B. Contract Manufacturing, Technical Coordination and Scale up

· Identify, evaluate and coordinate with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Conduct manufacturing facility visits and technical assessments to evaluate production capabilities, infrastructure, processes and quality systems.

· Coordinate product development and commercial manufacturing activities with external manufacturing partners.

· Review manufacturing feasibility, process limitations, production capacities, minimum order quantities and lead times.

· Monitor manufacturing progress, identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to ensure timely execution.

· Establish manufacturing timelines and align internal and external stakeholders on development, procurement, production and dispatch schedules.

· Coordinate with manufacturing partners for process improvements, production optimisation and resolution of technical issues.

C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control Coordination

· Coordinate manufacturer QA/QC teams to establish and maintain product quality standards.

· Review product specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), raw material documentation and finished product quality parameters.

· Establish and coordinate quality checkpoints across product development, sampling, manufacturing and finished goods evaluation.

· Coordinate product testing, analytical evaluation, stability studies and quality investigations.

· Review product samples for sensory attributes, physical characteristics and compliance with agreed specifications.

· Identify quality deviations and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with manufacturing partners.

· Ensure alignment between approved product specifications, manufacturing requirements and final commercial batches.

· Support quality documentation and product release-related activities.

D. Regulatory Affairs & Compliance

· Coordinate regulatory requirements for product development, manufacturing and commercialisation.

· Support FSSAI compliance, including product documentation, ingredient permissibility, product categorisation and labelling requirements.

· Review product labels, ingredient declarations, nutritional information, claims and regulatory artwork.

· Coordinate with regulatory teams and manufacturing partners for required licences, certifications, declarations and technical documentation.

· Support preparation and review of Free Sale Certificates, product descriptions, technical dossiers and other export-related documentation.

· Coordinate regulatory feasibility assessments for domestic and international product opportunities.

· Ensure product development and commercialisation activities remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Product Costing & Commercial Feasibility

· Coordinate product costing exercises for new and existing products.

· Evaluate ingredient costs, excipient systems, manufacturing charges, packaging costs and other associated expenses.

· Work with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain commercial quotations and develop product cost sheets.

· Identify opportunities for formulation optimisation, alternative ingredient sourcing and manufacturing efficiencies to improve product economics.

· Evaluate MOQ, batch sizes, production yields and manufacturing feasibility against commercial requirements.

· Support business development teams with technical and commercial inputs during client discussions and product proposals.

· Assess product feasibility from both technical and commercial perspectives before proceeding with development or commercial production.

F. Product Portfolio & Market Research

· Conduct market research to identify emerging nutraceutical ingredients, product formats, consumer trends and innovation opportunities.

· Evaluate new ingredients and technologies for potential inclusion in the company's product portfolio.

· Analyse competitor products, market positioning, formulation approaches and potential differentiation opportunities.

· Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion through innovative formulations, ingredient combinations and delivery formats.

· Coordinate technical evaluation and commercial feasibility of new product concepts.

· Support product positioning through technical information, formulation inputs and product development insights.

G. Commercial strategy

· Identify, evaluate and develop strategic relationships with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Develop commercial strategies to generate business through manufacturing partners by leveraging GCV's product portfolio, proprietary ingredients, formulation capabilities and innovation pipeline.

· Identify opportunities to introduce GCV-developed formulations and ready-to-launch products into manufacturers' existing client networks and business portfolios.

· Engage with manufacturers to understand their existing capabilities, client base, market reach and potential business opportunities for GCV.

H. Cross-functional Coordination & Project Management

· Act as a central coordination point between business development and external vendors.

· Develop and monitor project timelines covering formulation, sampling, procurement, packaging, testing, manufacturing and dispatch.

· Conduct regular follow-ups with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project milestones.

· Identify project risks, operational bottlenecks and interdepartmental dependencies and drive resolution.

· Coordinate internal project reviews and development meetings.

· Ensure appropriate documentation, communication and accountability throughout the product development and supply lifecycle.

· Provide management with project updates, manufacturing status, supply risks and development progress.

● B.Sc./ M.Sc. degree in food technology, biotechnology, microbi

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

jobs.description:
Product Innovation Lead

Product Innovation & R&D

Full-time

Founder / CEO

About Rasayanam

Rasayanam is a new-age nutrition and supplements brand built for people who want everyday progress without shortcuts.

We believe supplements should deliver meaningful results, be safe to use consistently, and earn trust through evidence rather than marketing claims. We focus on purposeful formulations, clinically supported ingredients and doses, transparent communication, and products designed for long-term use.

We are building for the Conscious Indian Improver - someone who wants results, asks questions, understands what they put into their body, and does not blindly trust brands.

This is also how we expect ourselves to work: high ownership, clear thinking, strong standards, and a bias toward doing what is right for the customer over what is easiest in the short term.

About the Role

At Rasayanam, we do not build products to follow trends—we build products customers can trust with their health. The Product Innovation Lead will own the end-to-end product journey, from identifying unmet customer needs to developing evidence-backed formulations ready for commercialization. Success in this role is measured not by launch volume, but by product quality, measurable customer outcomes, and the long-term trust our formulations earn.

What You’ll Own

* **End-to-End Product Innovation:**
  Identify meaningful customer health needs, manage the innovation pipeline, and lead formulation development from concept to commercial launch.
* **Scientific Research & Formulation Design:**
  Evaluate scientific literature and emerging ingredients to create safe, effective formulations with clearly defined usage protocols and evidence standards.
* **Safety, Quality & Regulatory Compliance:**
  Own testing, validation, certifications, and quality benchmarks while ensuring every product claim is scientifically defensible.
* **Customer Outcome Measurement:**
  Define expected health outcomes for every product and continuously refine formulations using real customer feedback and performance data.
* **Supplier & Manufacturing Qualification:**
  Evaluate and onboard ingredient suppliers and manufacturing partners to maintain high standards of traceability, transparency, and quality across the supply chain.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:**
  Partner closely with Marketing, CX, Operations, and Quality teams to build repeatable systems that strengthen product decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

**Must Have**

* 5–8+ years of professional experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, functional foods, pharmaceuticals, or related health and wellness categories.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience specifically in product development, formulation, or innovation roles.
* Strong ability to critically analyze scientific literature and translate clinical research into practical, safe product decisions.
* Direct experience managing regulatory compliance (e.g., FSSAI), certifications, quality standards, and third-party testing protocols.
* High ownership mindset with sharp analytical judgment, rigorous attention to detail, and an uncompromising commitment to long-term safety over short-term speed.

**Good to Have**

* Experience scaling D2C or consumer-first nutrition brands in the Indian market.
* Familiarity with clinical trial design or claim substantiation documentation.
* Strong existing network of vetted raw-ingredient suppliers and GMP-certified manufacturing partners.

How You’ll Work

We’re looking for people who:

* **Own outcomes, not just tasks.**
  You take responsibility from problem to resolution.
* **Move with urgency.**
  You act decisively without lowering the bar.
* **Think for yourself.**
  You bring a point of view, challenge assumptions, and use judgment.
* **Put the customer first.**
  You optimize for what is genuinely right for the customer, not what is easiest or most convenient.
* **Raise the bar.**
  You are never satisfied with “good enough” when better is possible.

Why Rasayanam

We’re building a brand that aims to make wellness more trustworthy, transparent, and genuinely useful for Indian consumers. At Rasayanam, you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with a growing team, take meaningful ownership, and help build something from the ground up.

About the Role

Aesthetic Training India is seeking a knowledgeable, practical, and detail-oriented
**Technical Cosmetics Consultant**
with hands-on experience in cosmetic formulation, laboratory-scale sample preparation, product development, testing, and technical documentation.

The successful candidate must be capable of independently developing cosmetic formulations and preparing lab-scale samples based on client requirements and product briefs. The role also involves formulation troubleshooting, technical research, client interaction, and coordination with manufacturers, laboratories, raw-material suppliers, and packaging vendors.

Key Responsibilities

* Independently formulate and prepare laboratory-scale samples for skincare, haircare, body-care, cleansing, hygiene, and other personal-care products.
* Convert client concepts and product briefs into practical cosmetic formulations.
* Calculate formulation percentages, accurately weigh raw materials, scale batches, and follow appropriate manufacturing processes.

* Evaluate samples for appearance, colour, fragrance, texture, pH, viscosity, stability, spreadability, foaming, rinse-off properties, and overall performance.
* Troubleshoot issues such as phase separation, instability, unsuitable viscosity, poor texture, preservation concerns, foaming problems, and ingredient incompatibility.
* Modify and optimise formulations according to performance requirements, stability observations, client feedback, target cost, and packaging compatibility.
* Review cosmetic formulations, ingredients, labels, and proposed product claims.
* Prepare formulation sheets, batch sheets, product specifications, sample-evaluation reports, testing plans, and other technical documentation.
* Coordinate stability, microbiological, preservative-efficacy, packaging-compatibility, dermatological, and claim-substantiation testing when required.
* Coordinate product-development activities with clients, third-party manufacturers, testing laboratories, suppliers, and packaging vendors.
* Maintain properly labelled samples, retained samples, formulation versions, batch records, trial histories, raw-material records, and development documentation.
* Follow laboratory hygiene, workplace-safety, raw-material handling, equipment-cleaning, and waste-disposal procedures.
* Research cosmetic ingredients, competitor products, suppliers, technologies, and industry developments.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding client formulations, product concepts, technical information, and intellectual property.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in
  **Cosmetic Technology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering**
  , or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in cosmetic formulation, product development, research and development, or laboratory operations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently formulate and prepare laboratory-scale cosmetic samples.
* Hands-on formulation experience in skincare, haircare, body-care, cleansing, or personal-care products.
* Sound knowledge of cosmetic raw materials, ingredient functionality, formulation techniques, preservation, stability, manufacturing processes, and product testing.
* Ability to calculate formulation percentages, scale batches, prepare formulation worksheets, and document processing parameters accurately.
* Experience using cosmetic laboratory equipment and evaluating basic quality parameters, including pH, viscosity, colour, odour, appearance, texture, and stability.
* Strong formulation-troubleshooting, technical-writing, research, communication, and project-coordination skills.
* Good written and spoken English and Hindi.
* Marathi language skills would be an advantage.

* Face washes and facial cleansers
* Creams, lotions, gels, and facial serums
* Shampoos, including sulfate-free and active shampoos
* Conditioners, hair masks, hair serums, and hair oils
* Body washes, scrubs, and body lotions
* Sunscreen and sun-care products
* Face masks and exfoliating products
* Lip-care products
* Professional salon and aesthetic skincare products

What We Offer

* Exposure to diverse cosmetic formulation and product-development projects
* Opportunities to work with cosmetic brands, entrepreneurs, manufacturers, laboratories, and suppliers
* Involvement in technical consulting, research, training, and product commercialisation
* A professional environment with opportunities for learning and career growth

The candidate should have exposure to the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, from microbial algae, along with a strong understanding of fermentation processes, process optimization, and scale-up. The role also requires effective coordination with downstream processing, quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing operations.

jobs.description:
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!

**At CEEW, we build careers in public policy**

* We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale
* We actively promote leadership by initiative
* We celebrate talent and ambition
* You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow

Senior Programme Lead

**Reporting to**
  
Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)

New Delhi, India

### **Purpose**

Systems change in food systems reform is impeded by entrenched political economy dynamics. We are looking for a leader who can not only navigate this political economy, but also orchestrate difficult, real change – rewriting political economy equations and enabling systemic transformation. They will build and lead a team working at the interface of political economy, public policy, and institutions, and will advance the Council’s research, policy engagement, and impact by helping the programme understand and navigate political economy while actively orchestrating systems-level change in India’s food systems.

* Build a network of contacts across government, political leadership, and public institutions to create sustained pathways for policy and institutional change.
* Spearhead coalition building with public institutions, political leadership, and civil society partners, in coordination with internal project streams, creating a high-leverage venue for catalytic action on political economy transitions.
* Lead the thinking on how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making in food systems; scope and develop new ideas and programmes to shift this political economy towards sustainability transitions.

### **Research**

* Lead research and intelligence-gathering on the political economy of food systems reform, including the role of institutions, regulatory environments, incentives, and narratives in shaping decision-making.
* Develop intelligence and strategies to shape the political economy of food systems towards sustainability transitions, and identify levers and entry points for orchestrating change.

jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.

Syngenta Crop Protection keeps plants safe from planting to harvesting. From the moment a seed is planted through to harvest, crops need to be protected from weeds, insects and diseases as well as droughts and floods, heat and cold.

jobs.title: ISO 22000 Auditor
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
“At QIMA, you feel like you belong from Day 1. You join a community of smart minds who not only innovate, but also support and inspire each other. Here, we own our work, have fun together, and make everyday count.”
  
  
The QIMA and EFRAC Story
  
  
At QIMA, our Food Division is dedicated to helping every member of the global food supply chain ensure the safety and quality of food products, as well as safe working conditions and sustainable practices. With inspections, audits and certifications, we support food growers, producers and retailers, as well as businesses in food service and hospitality, securing their food products' journey from farm to shelf and fork.
  
  
Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
  
  
EFRAC, part of QIMA group is a laboratory testing services company focusing on food safety, pharmaceutical quality control, and environmental monitoring.
  
  
What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
  
  
**Job Description**
The Role in Brief
  
  
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ISO 22000 Auditor to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting audits of food safety management systems in accordance with ISO 22000 standards. This role requires a comprehensive understanding of food safety principles, risk management, and the ability to assess compliance effectively.
  
  
**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include**

* Perform comprehensive audits of food safety management systems (FSMS) in accordance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Assess documentation, including food safety policies, procedures, and records, to ensure compliance with ISO requirements.
* Analyze the effectiveness of the FSMS, including hazard analysis and critical control points (HACCP), to identify potential risks.
* Detect areas of non-compliance or weaknesses in the FSMS and provide recommendations for corrective actions.
* If applicable, oversee the collection of samples for testing to verify compliance with safety standards.
* Prepare detailed audit reports summarizing findings, observations, and recommendations for improvements.

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Develop and implement audit plans for ISO 22000 compliance.
* Conduct thorough audits of food safety management systems, assessing processes, procedures, and documentation.
* Prepare detailed audit reports that highlight findings, non-conformities, and areas for improvement.
* Maintain accurate and organized records of all audit activities and compliance assessments.
* Collaborate with food business operators and staff to enhance understanding of ISO 22000 standards.
* Provide recommendations and support for corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay informed about industry trends and changes in regulations to ensure compliance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Recommend enhancements to audit processes and tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Engage in ongoing professional education to remain current with ISO standards and food safety practices.
* Attend relevant workshops, training sessions, and industry conferences.

Profile Requirements
  
  
**To Succeed In This Role, You Have**

* A food-related or bioscience degree (minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent) OR Atleast a successfully completed food-related professional higher education.
* At least 2 years of work experience in food industry
* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.
* HACCP course (minimum 16 hours) recognized by the International HACCP Alliance; and ISO 22000:2018 course (minimum of 16 hours) + Lead Auditor course (on QMS) of 40 hours of duration including the exam. OR Lead Auditor Course (FSMS (ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000) of 40 hours of duration including the exam.
* Minimum: 20 days as auditor of Quality Management Systems, Food Safety Management Systems or other Food Safety Standards (i.e. GFSI).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Qualifications**
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.
* HACCP course (minimum 16 hours) recognized by the International HACCP Alliance; and ISO 22000:2018 course (minimum of 16 hours) + Lead Auditor course (on QMS) of 40 hours of duration including the exam. OR Lead Auditor Course (FSMS (ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000) of 40 hours of duration including the exam.
* Minimum: 20 days as auditor of Quality Management Systems, Food Safety Management Systems or other Food Safety Standards (i.e. GFSI).

If you possess the skills and experience required for this role and are passionate about driving business growth in the food industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as our Regional Sales Manager.

jobs.title: Lead Corporate Affairs
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
As a world market leader in crop protection, we help farmers to counter these threats and ensure enough safe, nutritious, affordable food for all – while minimizing the use of land and other agricultural inputs.
  
  
Syngenta Crop Protection keeps plants safe from planting to harvesting. From the moment a seed is planted through to harvest, crops need to be protected from weeds, insects and diseases as well as droughts and floods, heat and cold.
  
  
Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Switzerland.

**ROLE PURPOSE**
**To support the strategic direction and achievement of business objectives of Syngenta in India, enhancing freedom to operate through building and maintaining Syngenta’s reputation externally.**

* To support the strategic direction and achievement of Syngenta’s business objectives in India by enhancing its freedom to operate, strengthening external reputation, and driving effective corporate affairs, government relations and public policy engagement.
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in developing and implementing the regional Corporate Affairs strategy, translating regional priorities into India-specific action plans and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
* Develop and implement an India Corporate Affairs action plan in consultation with the Head of Corporate Affairs to support business objectives, ensure consistent engagement with key stakeholders, and strengthen Syngenta’s reputation in India.
* Work with business leaders and commercial unit heads to implement local and regional programs, ensuring disciplined and consistent internal and external communications, systematic stakeholder mapping, and effective stakeholder engagement.'

**Accountabilities**
**Reputation Management, Governmental and Public Affairs**

* Develop a Corporate Affairs & Reputation Management action plan for India that supports the delivery of the regional corporate affairs strategy, and which is specific to the circumstances, issues and stakeholders in India. The approach should identify key stakeholders (government, research institutes, NGOs, media, investors, academics etc) and their influencers across the region and form the basis for detailed action and engagement plans.

* Support external communications and media relations in India in collaboration with appointed PR agencies, including communication planning, media engagement, press releases, media briefings and other external communication materials, ensuring consistency with Syngenta’s corporate positioning and messaging.
* Deliver pro-active reputation management (identification, informing, educating and influencing), particularly with key government stakeholders relevant issues (e.g. technology acceptance, public private partnerships and collaborations, regulatory policy and implementation in concert with regulatory affairs through a “License to Operate” environment) with disciplined and consistent stakeholder management activities including the use of direct engagement and the full array of communication and influence channels – media, public forums, industry groups, speeches and keynotes etc.

Ensuring wherever possible the alignment between stakeholder objectives and Syngenta’s own objectives.

* Ensure a consistent approach to reputation management through adoption of best practice common procedures and tools and sharing of best practices within business units

**Public Policy / Public Relations**

* Partners with non-government think tanks, state industry bodies, farmer networks, and NGOs to advance policy advocacy and reputation management objectives.

**Qualifications**
**Critical Knowledge & Experience:**

* 15+ years of experience in Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Public Policy, or Reputation Management within a multinational organization (agriculture, biotech, or allied sectors preferred).

**Critical Skills**

* Strong understanding of regulatory and policy frameworks with the ability to navigate government processes and registration requirements
* Ability to work independently and build effective networks across stakeholders in India and within the organization.

* Proactive, self motivating, decisive, high level of crisis tolerance.

**Other Behaviors, Critical For The Role**
Good team player. Interpersonal skills. Attention to detail; ability to find win-win solutions; ability to serve as a conduit in the flow of information between communications team and business units; flexibility in a fast-paced organization; ability to frequently measure the effectiveness of ongoing programs and adapt accordingly.

Job Title: Quality Analyst – Food, Dairy & Sweets Manufacturing

**Company:** Bikanervala  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Department:** Quality Assurance / Quality Control  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Industry:** Food Processing, Dairy Products, Sweets & Confectionery

Job Summary

Bikanervala is looking for a dedicated and experienced Quality Analyst with practical knowledge of food quality control, dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety, hygiene, process control and regulatory compliance across food production and processing operations.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in dairy products, khoya/mawa, paneer, ghee, milk-based sweets and traditional Indian sweets, along with knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000 standards.

Key Responsibilities1. Raw Material Quality Inspection

* Inspect incoming raw materials such as milk, cream, khoya, paneer, ghee, sugar, flour, besan, dry fruits, edible oils and other food ingredients.
* Check raw material quality, freshness, specifications and supplier COAs.
* Conduct physical, chemical and sensory inspections.
* Monitor milk quality parameters, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Identify and segregate rejected or non-conforming raw materials.
* Maintain incoming material inspection records.

2. In-Process Quality Control – Dairy Products

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of milk, paneer, curd, yoghurt, ghee, butter, khoa and other dairy products.
* Monitor pasteurisation temperature and holding time.
* Check milk fat, SNF, acidity, pH and moisture.
* Monitor coagulation, fermentation, cooling and processing parameters.
* Ensure product consistency, texture, colour and taste.
* Monitor chilling, cold storage and hygienic handling practices.

3. In-Process Quality Control – Indian Sweets

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of Rasgulla, Rasmalai, Gulab Jamun, Kaju Katli, Barfi, Peda, Kalakand, Milk Cake, Besan Laddu, Motichoor Laddu and other traditional sweets.
* Monitor sugar syrup concentration using a refractometer (Brix).
* Check cooking temperature and processing time.
* Monitor moisture, texture, colour, taste and consistency.
* Check frying temperature and frying oil quality.
* Ensure uniformity in product size, weight, shape and appearance.
* Monitor cooling, handling and storage conditions.

4. Finished Product Quality Inspection

* Conduct final quality inspections before product release.
* Perform sensory evaluation for appearance, colour, taste, aroma and texture.
* Check product weight, moisture, pH, acidity, fat and Brix wherever applicable.
* Verify packaging quality, sealing and product labelling.
* Monitor batch number, manufacturing date and expiry date.
* Coordinate microbiological testing.
* Ensure finished products meet approved quality specifications.

5. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations and applicable food safety requirements.
* Monitor personal hygiene and food handling practices of production employees.
* Conduct regular production-floor hygiene inspections.
* Ensure proper cleaning and sanitation of equipment, utensils, processing areas and machinery.
* Monitor pest control, waste disposal and water quality.
* Prevent cross-contamination and allergen contamination.
* Verify cleaning and sanitation records.

6. Food Safety Management Systems

* Implement and monitor HACCP-based food safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GHP and SSOP.
* Support implementation and maintenance of ISO 22000 standards.
* Identify potential biological, chemical and physical hazards.
* Monitor Critical Control Points (CCPs) and applicable OPRPs.
* Maintain food safety monitoring and verification records.
* Ensure calibration of laboratory and quality inspection instruments.

7. Laboratory Testing & Analysis

* Perform routine physical and chemical testing of raw materials and finished products.
* Conduct milk testing for fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Perform moisture, pH, acidity and Brix analysis.
* Monitor frying oil quality and deterioration.
* Coordinate microbiological testing, including total plate count, yeast and mould, coliforms and other applicable parameters.
* Maintain laboratory records and test reports.
* Coordinate external laboratory testing when required.

8. Quality Audits & Documentation

* Conduct daily quality inspections and internal hygiene audits.
* Identify non-conformities and process deviations.
* Perform root cause analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone techniques.
* Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Maintain raw material inspection reports, production quality records, CCP monitoring sheets, laboratory reports, cleaning records and audit documentation.
* Support internal, external, FSSAI and customer audits.
* Maintain product traceability and recall-related records.

9. Coordination with Production & Operations

* Coordinate with production teams to maintain consistent product quality.
* Identify and resolve quality issues during manufacturing.
* Communicate deviations and recommend corrective measures.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse and operations teams.
* Monitor customer complaints, product rejections and quality improvement activities.
* Conduct food safety and hygiene awareness training for production employees.

Required Skills & Technical Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations and food safety standards.
* Practical knowledge of dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience in HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000.
* Knowledge of milk testing, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Knowledge of khoya/mawa quality testing and moisture analysis.
* Experience in Brix testing using a refractometer.
* Knowledge of frying oil quality monitoring.
* Understanding of microbiological testing and shelf-life evaluation.
* Knowledge of CAPA, root cause analysis and internal quality audits.
* Good analytical, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Strong documentation and reporting abilities.

Important Practical Skills Required

Candidates with hands-on experience in the following areas will be preferred:

* Milk quality testing and dairy product analysis.
* Khoya/Mawa quality inspection.
* Sugar syrup concentration testing (Brix).
* Moisture analysis of sweets and dairy products.
* Frying oil quality monitoring.
* Microbiological testing and hygiene monitoring.
* Shelf-life evaluation of dairy products and Indian sweets.
* Finished product sensory evaluation.
* Production-floor quality monitoring and batch inspection.
* Educational Qualification
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology.

Experience Required

* 1–5 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control.
* Experience in dairy, sweets, confectionery or food processing manufacturing will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant educational qualifications may also be considered.
* B.Tech. / M.Tech. in Food Technology.
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Dairy Technology.
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Microbiology or Biotechnology with relevant food industry experience.
* Diploma in Food Processing or Dairy Technology with relevant practical experience.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant experience in Food Processing, Dairy and Indian Sweets Manufacturing can share their updated resumes or contact HR directly.

**About Envirocare Labs**

Envirocare Labs is a premier NABL-accredited laboratory with over 45 years of excellence in analytical testing, inspection, and certification services. Recognized by FSSAI, BIS, APEDA, AGMARK, and other regulatory bodies, we specialize in food, water, environmental, and pharmaceutical testing. Our Goa facility is equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation and staffed by a team of dedicated scientists committed to quality and precision.

**Job Purpose**

The Food Analyst will be responsible for the end-to-end handling and release of regulatory samples received from FSSAI, FDA, and other authorities. This role requires strong analytical acumen, attention to detail in documentation, strict adherence to regulatory protocols, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with FSSR and other applicable standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and verify accompanying documentation for regulatory samples received from authorities. Coordinate with officials for any clarifications required.

* Participate in the submission of regulatory data, including monthly testing summaries, feasibility responses, and other official communications as required by FSSAI or FDA.
* Supervise laboratory personnel engaged in food testing activities and ensure adherence to quality protocols.
* Review test results generated by junior analysts and technicians for completeness and accuracy.
* Train and mentor team members on regulatory testing methodologies and best practices.
* Stay updated with changes in FSSAI guidelines, methods, and relevant national/international food laws to ensure continuous compliance.

**Qualifications**

* Educational Background: Master’s degree in Chemistry (Analytical, Organic, or Inorganic), B.Tech in Food Technology, or any other degree with specialization in Food Technology.

We are looking for a Legal Executive / Paralegal who can support the company in managing agreements, legal documentation, compliance tracking and coordination with internal departments and external lawyers.

The candidate should be detail-oriented, organised and capable of independently maintaining legal records, agreement trackers, compliance calendars and first-level review of commercial documents. The role will require regular follow-up with internal teams, vendors, landlords, consultants and external legal advisors.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Agreement Management**

* Maintain a complete tracker of all company agreements, including vendor agreements, mall agreements, lease agreements, distributor agreements, service contracts, NDAs, employment-related agreements and other commercial documents.
* Review agreements at a first level and highlight key legal and commercial points such as tenure, lock-in, notice period, termination, indemnity, liability, jurisdiction, renewal, payment terms and penalties.
* Prepare agreement summaries for management approval.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external lawyers for drafting, review, negotiation and closure of agreements.
* Ensure proper execution, stamping, signing and storage of all agreements.
* Track agreement expiry dates, renewal dates and notice period deadlines.

**2. Compliance Management**

* Prepare and maintain a compliance calendar for all company-level requirements.
* Coordinate for statutory and regulatory compliances such as ROC, GST, shop & establishment, labour law, factory licences, legal metrology, trademark, FSSAI or other applicable business compliances.
* Follow up with concerned departments to ensure timely submission of documents and completion of compliance tasks.
* Maintain proper digital and physical records of licences, renewals, filings and approvals.
* Escalate pending or critical compliance matters to management in a timely manner.

**3. Legal Coordination**

* Coordinate with external lawyers, consultants, company secretary, auditors and other advisors.
* Assist in handling legal notices, disputes, vendor issues and documentation-related matters.
* Prepare basic legal letters, authorisation letters, board resolution drafts, POAs and internal notes wherever required.
* Maintain confidentiality of all legal, commercial and company-sensitive documents.

**4. Internal Process & Documentation**

* Create and maintain structured folders for all legal documents.
* Prepare MIS reports for pending agreements, expiring agreements, compliance status and legal matters.
* Follow up with internal teams for pending inputs, documents and approvals.
* Ensure that no agreement, renewal or compliance deadline is missed.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of basic commercial agreements and legal clauses.
* Strong drafting and communication skills.
* Good follow-up ability with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills for maintaining trackers.
* Ability to read agreements carefully and identify risk areas.
* Organised, detail-oriented and deadline-driven.
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple departments.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

**Preferred Experience**

* 7-8 years of experience in legal documentation, paralegal work, agreement management or compliance coordination.
* Prior experience in a company, law firm, retail, FMCG, manufacturing, real estate, mall leasing or corporate legal department will be preferred.
* Experience with vendor agreements, lease agreements, mall agreements, distributor agreements and compliance calendars will be an advantage.

**Qualification**

* LLB / Legal studies background preferred.
* Candidates with strong paralegal or legal documentation experience may also be considered.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

**Job Title:**Assistant QA Manager – Food Safety & Quality Systems

**Company:** CTB Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Salary:** ₹50,000–₹60,000 gross per month, plus employer PF and annual performance bonus as per company policy.

About the Company

CTB Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. is a growing B2B bakery manufacturer supplying burger buns, breads, pitas, pizza bases and specialty bakery products to restaurants, cafés, QSRs and cloud kitchens.

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, hands-on QA professional to **take ownership of our quality assurance and food safety function**.

This is a leadership role requiring someone who can independently assess existing practices, establish effective quality systems, implement improvements and ensure consistent standards throughout our manufacturing operations.

**We are looking for a person who takes initiative, solves problems and drives results—not someone who simply conducts inspections or maintains records.**

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead and develop the QA/QC function**, establishing effective quality systems, SOPs, inspection procedures and operational controls.
* **Ensure product quality and process compliance** throughout manufacturing, from incoming materials and ingredient preparation to production, packaging and finished goods.
* **Own food safety and regulatory compliance**, including FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, sanitation, hygiene, audits and required documentation.
* **Establish and maintain traceability, quality records and product release controls**, ensuring audit readiness and effective management of nonconformities.
* **Investigate quality issues and customer complaints**, identify root causes, implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and prevent recurrence.
* **Lead and guide QA personnel**, train production teams and work closely with other departments to ensure quality standards are consistently followed.
* **Drive continuous improvement**, proactively identifying weaknesses, implementing practical solutions and monitoring measurable results.
* Report quality performance and critical risks directly to management, taking responsibility for follow-up and resolution.

Candidate Requirements

* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology or a related discipline.
* Minimum **5 years of QA/QC experience in food manufacturing**; bakery experience preferred.
* Strong practical knowledge of FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, quality documentation and audits.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or improving QA systems, SOPs, process controls and CAPA.
* Ability to independently manage QA activities, guide staff and coordinate effectively with production teams.
* Strong organizational, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Hands-on approach, high personal accountability and the ability to follow through without constant supervision.

**Preference will be given to candidates who have personally established, implemented or substantially improved quality systems in a food manufacturing facility.**

What We Offer

An opportunity to lead and develop the quality function of a growing food manufacturing company, with significant autonomy, direct interaction with management and the ability to make a measurable impact.

**Work Schedule:** Primarily daytime hours, with flexibility for occasional night-time production visits as required. This is not a permanent night-shift position.

jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Raw Material & Packaging Inspection:** Conduct thorough quality checks on incoming raw materials (grains, pulses, edible oils, spices, seasonings) and packaging materials against approved specifications before releasing them for production.

* **Root Cause Analysis & CAPA:** Investigate customer complaints, in-process rejections, or non-conformities; implement effective Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to minimize wastage and rework.
* **Laboratory & Calibration Management:** Oversee routine chemical, physical, and microbiological testing in the QC lab, ensuring proper calibration and maintenance of testing instruments.
* **Documentation & Audit Readiness:** Maintain accurate daily QC logs, COA (Certificate of Analysis) records, batch manufacturing records, and hygiene checklists to ensure readiness for internal, third-party, and FSSAI audits.
* **Team Supervision:** Guide and train QC chemists/inspectors and shop-floor operators on hygiene protocols, quality standards, and SOP adherence.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This position involves developing innovative food and beverage products with a specific focus on food formulation and microencapsulation technologies. The role includes developing and optimising food formulations, working with microencapsulated ingredients, evaluating encapsulation techniques, and improving ingredient stability, functionality, solubility, dispersibility and controlled release properties in food applications.

The candidate will be responsible for executing laboratory-scale trials, ingredient selection, formulation optimisation, product testing and supporting the scale-up and commercialisation of new products. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate innovative ingredient technologies into commercially viable food products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, optimise and validate food and beverage formulations based on product requirements and application needs.
* Work on microencapsulation of functional food ingredients, including flavours, colours, vitamins, minerals, oils, probiotics and other bioactive ingredients.
* Explore and work with microencapsulation techniques such as spray drying, coacervation, emulsification and other relevant encapsulation technologies.
* Identify and evaluate suitable core materials, wall materials, carriers and encapsulating agents for different food applications.
* Conduct laboratory-scale experiments and optimise formulation and process parameters to improve encapsulation efficiency, stability and product performance.
* Evaluate the physicochemical properties of encapsulated ingredients, including particle size, moisture content, solubility, dispersibility, encapsulation efficiency and stability, wherever applicable.
* Incorporate microencapsulated ingredients into different food matrices and evaluate their functionality, compatibility and performance.
* Conduct ingredient calculations, proximate analysis, sensory evaluation and shelf-life studies.
* Evaluate and select suitable wall materials and carrier materials based on ingredient compatibility, encapsulation efficiency, stability and intended food application.
* Develop and optimise formulations based on food safety, regulatory requirements, quality standards and commercial feasibility.
* Coordinate with R&D, quality, production and other cross-functional teams for product trials, process optimisation and scale-up.
* Maintain experimental records, prepare technical reports and document product development activities.
* Stay updated on emerging encapsulation technologies, functional ingredients and innovations in food science.

**Qualifications:**  
Master’s or Ph.D. in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, Culinary Arts, or related field

**Responsibility and Decision-Making Authority:**  
Empowered to make project and cross-functional decisions in partnership with peers.

**Experience:**  
Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in food product development, food formulation or applied food science R&D, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience in microencapsulation technology, encapsulated ingredient development or application of microencapsulated ingredients in food formulations.

Hands-on experience in spray drying, coacervation, emulsion-based encapsulation or application of microencapsulated ingredients in food products will be preferred.

**Travel:**  
Ability to travel as required

**Location:**  
Bio 360 Lifesciences Park, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala

As per industry. Will consider higher for deserving candidates
