The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).
* Publications: Minimum 3–5 publications in peer-reviewed journals; patents or book chapters preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional R&D teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Location**
Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. jobs.title: Scientific Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.
  
  
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**
**Role Summary**
**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**
The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.
  
  
This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.
  
  
The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.
  
  
**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**
This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.
  
  
Role duties and accountabilities
  
  

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

**Experience, Skills, Knowledge**
Experience Required
  
  

* 5-10 years of experience in relevant scientific field
* Proven expertise engaging with and mobilising scientific KOLs / PHAs and interest groups
* Knowledge and experience of BAT's New Category products, ingredients, and technologies
* Familiarity with BAT’s 9-step scientific risk assessment framework and Tobacco Harm Reduction principles
* Sound knowledge of tobacco, food, or pharmaceutical science complexities including chemistry, toxicology, pre-clinical, clinical, and behavioural science
* Understanding of the regulatory environment in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, especially concerning tobacco, food, medicinal, and pharmaceutical sectors
* Proven experience interacting with regulatory authorities in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, managing pharmaceutical regulations, regulatory pathways, and scientific requirements, with the capacity to apply this knowledge to complex scientific and policy discussions
* Experience in managing complex market-facing and regulatory dependent projects
* Understands World Health Organization’s political environment and public policy-making processes
* Experience of crafting and managing 3rd party networks
* Experience in regulatory rulemaking processes
* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Outstanding communication abilities

**Technical / Functional / Leadership Skills Required**

* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Strong communication capabilities

**Education / Professional Qualifications / Certifications Required**

* Educated to a post-graduate degree (PhD or equivalent experience, MD, or Pharmacist)
* Excellent written and spoken English

Beneficial
  
  

* Appreciation of challenges of working in a complex matrix environment and proven experience of delivering results
* Active interest in controversial regulatory control issues and skills for absorbing and applying knowledge to the debate

**What we offer you?**

* We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
* Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
* Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter

jobs.title: F&B Licensing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Wynn Al Marjan Island:**
Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, water features, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.
  
  
**About The Position**
Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking F&B Licensing Manager to join the resort’s Food & Beverage team.
  
  
**The Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Are**

* Build and maintain the end ‑ to ‑ end licensing roadmap for Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars/lounges, in ‑ venue service points, storage areas, kitchens, outdoor spaces), mapping initial approvals, renewals, amendments, and closures.
* Own a central license register (master tracker) covering legal entity documents, trade/operational licenses, alcohol/beverage permissions where applicable, health & hygiene certificates, music/entertainment permits, signage, outdoor seating, terrace use, delivery, and vehicle/transport approvals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant Emirate ‑ level and federal authorities (e.g., Economic Development, Municipality/Public Health, Tourism Authority, Civil Defense, Police/Events, and other regulators as applicable) to obtain, amend, and renew approvals.
* Interpret new regulations, assess impact, and update SOPs; cascade requirements across venues and support implementation.
* Lead all event ‑ related licensing and notifications (e.g., celebrations, tastings, brand activations, outdoor events, one ‑ off extensions of hours/areas), coordinating site plans, crowd management, entertainment permits, and security/Civil Defense clearances.
* Partner with Restaurant Events and venue leaders to build permit ‑ ready event packs (layouts, capacities, NOCs, risk assessments) and to secure approvals on time
* Oversee authorized PROs, translation/legalization services, and specialized consultants; negotiate scopes, SLAs, and fees.
* Maintain a calendar of statutory payments (govt. fees, renewals, inspections) and forecast the licensing budget; reconcile costs against plan.
* Maintain accurate license files (digital and physical), logs of submissions and approvals, and a library of approved layouts/certificates.
* Publish weekly dashboards (licenses due in 90/60/30 days, event permits in progress, inspection outcomes, fines/penalties avoided).
* Run the daily licensing control room: check expiries, validate opening checklists for permit ‑ dependent activities, and green ‑ light venue operations.
* Review event requests; confirm permitting path, lead times, and documentation; submit and track approvals through to issuance.
* Verify display of licenses (where mandated), on ‑ site documentation (HACCP, allergen matrices, employee certifications), and emergency contacts.
* Work with the respective outlet management team and designate Venue Licensing Champions in each outlet.
* Conduct induction and refresher training on licensing rules (alcohol service where applicable, events, outdoor use, deliveries, signage), documentation, and inspection etiquette.
* Monitor UAE market and regulatory trends; recommend operational adjustments and process improvements.
* Collaborate positively with all departments and contractors; lead cross ‑ functional licensing meetings and share relevant updates.

**About You:**
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 4–6 years in licensing/compliance for hospitality/Food & Beverage, large venues, or integrated resorts in the UAE; proven track record managing multi ‑ venue portfolios and events permits.
* Working knowledge of UAE/Emirate ‑ level licensing frameworks, municipal public health, tourism/entertainment permits, Civil Defense requirements, and HACCP/food safety.
* Advantageous: experience with alcohol licensing and responsible service standards where applicable; Arabic reading or business proficiency.
* Familiarity with e ‑ government portals and document legalization/attestation processes.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, document management systems, and tracker dashboards (e.g., Excel/SharePoint/Power BI).

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

Set along a two-kilometre stretch of private coastline, Madinat Jumeirah is a beachfront resort comprising four distinctive hotels. Each offers uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, with experiences ranging from the contemporary elegance of Jumeirah Al Naseem to the majestic Arabesque charm of Jumeirah Al Qasr. jobs.title: Projects & Financial Planning Analyst ( Development Projects)
jobs.company: Mohammad Omar Bin Haider Group (MOBH Group)
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Projects & Financial Planning Analyst will be responsible for preparing economic and financial feasibility studies for new and existing projects, monitoring project progress and performance, and preparing accurate and well-structured financial and management reports for senior management.

The position requires strong analytical, financial, reporting, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate and prepare professional reports in both Arabic and English.

The Projects & Financial Planning Analyst will be responsible for preparing economic and financial feasibility studies for new and existing real estate development projects, monitoring project progress and performance, and preparing accurate and well-structured financial and management reports for senior management. The role will cover the various stages of the project lifecycle, from the design and planning stage through construction, completion, and handover, including monitoring project timelines, costs, budgets, and overall performance.

The position requires strong analytical, financial, reporting, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate and prepare professional reports in both Arabic and English.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Feasibility Studies & Financial Analysis**

• Prepare comprehensive economic and financial feasibility studies for proposed projects.

• Develop project financial models, budgets, cash flow projections, revenue and cost analyses.

• Assess project profitability, financial viability, risks, and potential returns.

• Prepare financial assumptions and scenarios to support management decision-making.

• Conduct sensitivity and scenario analysis where required.

**Project Monitoring & Follow-up**

• Monitor the progress of projects against approved plans, budgets, timelines, and key milestones.

• Coordinate with relevant departments, consultants, contractors, and project teams to obtain updated information.

• Identify delays, cost variations, risks, and other issues affecting project performance.

• Follow up on outstanding actions and provide management with regular updates.

• Financial & Management Reporting

• Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad-hoc project reports.

• Prepare financial performance reports, including budget versus actual analysis, project costs, revenues, cash flow, and variances.

• Consolidate project information into clear management reports.

• Highlight key issues, risks, financial implications, and required management actions.

**Reporting & Presentations**

• Prepare professional reports and presentations using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other relevant tools.

• Develop dashboards, financial summaries, charts, graphs, and management presentations.

• Present complex financial and project information in a clear and understandable format.

• Ensure all reports are accurate, consistent, professional, and properly structured.

**Bilingual Reporting**

• Prepare and present reports and management information in both Arabic and English.

• Translate and adapt financial and project-related information between Arabic and English while maintaining professional terminology and accuracy.

**Management Support**

• Provide management with timely analysis and information required for strategic and operational decisions.

• Support management in evaluating new investment and development opportunities.

• Prepare ad-hoc analysis, financial studies, presentations, and reports as requested by management.

**Key Competencies:**

* Financial Analysis & Modelling
* Feasibility Studies
* Project Monitoring & Controls
* Management Reporting
* Budgeting & Forecasting
* Data Analysis
* Business Presentation
* Attention to Detail
* Communication & Coordination
* Strategic Thinking
* Arabic & English Reporting

**Skills**

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience in project analysis, financial planning, feasibility studies, project controls, or management reporting.

• Strong knowledge of financial analysis and financial modelling.

• Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including financial models, formulas, Pivot Tables, charts, and data analysis.

• Strong PowerPoint and Word presentation and report-writing skills.

• Ability to prepare professional management dashboards and presentations.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong project follow-up and coordination skills.

• Excellent written and spoken Arabic and English.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet reporting deadlines.

• Experience in real estate, construction, development, investment, or other project-based businesses would be an advantage.

Invoicing & Delivery Management

* Perform financial transactions and process invoices in a timely manner.
* Ensure all AFM document processes are strictly adhered to, ensuring all bank payments are met.
* Ensure revenue/provision processes are accurate and the assignee clause is error-free.
* Substantiate financial transactions by auditing documents.
* Record and maintain all financial operations.
* Manage intra-company and government sales transactions.
* Authorize all in-house AFM sales and credit customers.
* Produce daily invoice summaries for credit invoices and sales return cases; monitor all outstanding debts and report accordingly.
* Support and guide Matrix Managers, Sales team, and Sales Admin.

Cash (Revenue & Petty Cash Fund) Management

* Collect and verify all cash/credit card/cheque payments against invoices and post collections in SAP.
* Monitor petty cash float to ensure adequate balance and review pending reimbursements/claims for submission.

* Monitor and communicate cheque clearance, bouncing cheques, and refund cheques.

* Post sublet and bought-out charges to job cards for customer billing.

* Perform surprise cash counts as per SOP.

Financial Reporting, Cost & Internal Controls

* Conduct finance-related processes in compliance with AFM policies and procedures (SOPs).
* Support monitoring of Opex and Capex.
* Ensure AFM administration document processes are adhered to at all times.
* Monitor clearance of open POs and follow up with COT and showroom admin team monthly.
* Carry out ad hoc tasks/reports as required by the FBP/FM/Branch Management.

Accounts Receivables Management (AR Management)

* Review and ensure timely submission of second sets.
* Daily/weekly/monthly monitoring of branch AR report and follow-up with channels for timely collection of outstanding/overdue invoices.

* Proficiency in SAP and financial transaction processing.
* Ability to perform detailed audits and ensure compliance with financial procedures.
* Strong skills in cash management and reporting.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

* Bachelor's degree in accountancy or finance.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar role.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in financial software and systems (e.g., SAP) and financial analysis.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst - BP&A | Al-Futtaim | Retail
jobs.description:
**About Al-Futtaim**

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview Of The Role:**

  

The Financial Analyst role is crucial for supporting the strategic financial operations within the Retail Finance division of Al-Futtaim Group. The position involves assisting in strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting. It requires proactive communication with various business units and efficient management of information to deliver timely and accurate financial insights. The Analyst will work closely under the supervision of the BP&A Team, playing a vital part in driving automation and supporting project management activities.

  

**What You Will Do:**

  
 **Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting**  

* Assist the BP&A Team to manage the Strategic Plan, Budget, and Forecasts.
* Ensure accurate and timely completion of planning responsibilities.

**Reporting, Financial Analysis, Contingency Planning**  

* Assist the BP&A Team to prepare and circulate regular and ad-hoc reports and financial analysis.
* Ensure accurate and timely completion of reporting responsibilities.

**Automation / Projects**  

* Assist the BP&A Team in project-related activities, focusing on automation and efficiency improvements.
* Ensure accurate and timely completion of automation and project responsibilities.

**Administration**  

* Provide administrative support to BP&A Head and Team.
* Ensure timely provision of required support to the team.

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

  

* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and planning skills.
* Good business acumen.
* Ability to develop and maintain healthy relationships with colleagues.

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

  

* Commerce graduate with 4 years of experience in finance systems.
* Working knowledge of budgeting and financial/management reporting.
* Experience in the Middle East, preferably in the retail sector.

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.

  

Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.

jobs.title: Senior Internal Auditor
jobs.description:
Job Purpose   

Perform assigned audit engagements, from start to finish, inclusive of preplanning and wrap up activities. Applies risk and control concepts to scenarios encountered and identifies any potential issues.   
Assist in the periodic Risk Assessments and development of the Risk-Based Work Plans and the periodic reporting to the Audit Committee and Senior Management on internal audit activities, performance, significant risk exposures, controls/governance issues and other related matters.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 1)   

**Professional Ethics**  
•    Participate in initiating/promoting the establishment and continuous improvement of the Corporate Governance Framework including Enterprise Risk Management, Corporate Code of Conduct, Ethics and Values.  
**Internal Audit Plan**  
•     Assist in the development of Annual Audit Plan (AAP) based on the results of risk assessment exercise.  
•     Provide input for the periodic reporting on audit activities and performance relative to its plans, significant risk exposures, control/governance issues and other related matters.  
**Audit Execution**  
•    Assist the auditors in the examination and analysis of records through executing audit program steps for the assigned audits.  
•    Develop process understanding of assigned business processes and determines business objectives, main functions, the nature of activities, potential risks and controls to be reviewed.Develop a detailed audit program / Risk & Control Matrix (RCM) for the assigned audit including the objectives, potential risk, key controls, audit procedures and the use of audit techniques and tools to evaluate governance, risks and controls processes, and submits audit program to for review and approval.  
•    Determine auditing procedures to be applied, including the use of Information Systems Audit Techniques, statistical sampling method or others.Ensure that adequate working papers and all relevant information are continuously documented and updated in the automated Audit Management System in accordance with pre-defined templates and audit procedures.  
•    Perform the audit in accordance with the approved audit program and ensures that audit objectives have been met to support the audit conclusions/results.  
•    Identify, obtain, analyse and appraise related systems and evidentiary data/information.  
•    Prepare working papers which record and summarize data on the assigned audit and the results of the audit examination.  
•    Appraise the adequacy of the corrective actions taken by management on audit recommendations through follow up audits and periodically reviews and updates the status of management action plans.   
•    Ensures that approved audit objectives have been met with adequate coverage of all relevant areas. Also ensures that sufficient appropriate audit evidence is obtained to support the conclusion and recommendations, and that the work has been performed in accordance with professional audit standards.  
•    Participate in conducting special reviews and undertakes administrative duties as directed by Head of Internal Audit.  
•    Perform (also supervises audits performed by Internal Auditors) in accordance with the approved RACM and professional standards on internal auditing.  
•    Ensures tasks assigned to junior staff are adequately performed and deliverables are in accordance with ADNOC Internal Audit procedures and quality standards.  
•    Identify high risk areas and key control points of the system to be reviewed.  
•    Evaluate the system’s effectiveness based on his / her business and audit experience and modifies, if necessary, the scope of the review, with the approval of Team Leader / Department Manager.  
•    Participate in special committees to provide independent and objective professional advice and consultancy services.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 2)   

**Audit Reports**  
•    Prepare audit report with conclusion, expressing professional opinions on the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management, control systems and the efficiency with which activities are carried out. Recommends improvement options to rectify reported deficiencies, for Team Leader / Department Manager’s review.  
•    Recommend practical improvements options corresponding to the observations with an objective to contribute to the improvement of governance, risks and control processes to assist in the achievement of the company business objectives.  
•    Follow- up on replies to issued draft and final audit reports and review the adequacy of the corrective actions taken on audit recommendations / improvement options.  
**Coordination**  
•    Assist Audit Management in arranging Audit Committee meetings, preparing the agenda, and minutes of meetings (MOMs) and reporting on Corporate Governance Framework, General Controls and other related issues as prescribed in the Audit Committee Charter.   
•    Conducts workshops or presentations to create awareness about IA function and demonstrate value addition across the ADNOC.  
•    Communicates identified issues with Internal Audit management to ensure potential high risk area of concerns are addressed in a timely and effective manner.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**  
•    Participate in the development and implementation of the automated Audit Management System.  
•    Provide professional advice on Group Companies’ Audit Committee Charter,   
**IA Charter and IA Methodology/Procedures. Provides assistance in the establishment of the Group Audit Committees/IA functions and related governance, when assigned.**  
•    Participate in initiating and coordinating the Group-wide specialized professional training programs.   
•    Conducts research and benchmarking to resolve audit issues, identify gaps and support IA function.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 3)   
  
Generic Accountabilities   

**Supervision**  
•    Plan, supervise and coordinate all activities in the assigned area to meet functional objectives.  
•    Train and develop the assigned staff on relevant skills to enable them to become proficient on the job and deliver the respective section objectives.  
**Budgets**  
•    Provide input for preparation of the Section / Department budgets and assist in the implementation of the approved Budget and work plans to deliver Section objectives.   
•    Investigate and highlight any significant variances to support effective performance and cost control  
**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures**  
•    Implement approved Section / Department policies, processes, systems, standards and procedures in order to support execution of the Section’s / Department work programs in line with Company and International standards.  
**Performance Management**  
•    Contribute to the achievement of the approved Performance Objectives for the Section / Department in line with the Company Performance framework.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**  
•    Design and implement new tools and techniques to improve the quality and efficiency of operational processes.  
•    Identify improvements in internal processes against best practices in pursuit of greater efficiency in line with ISO standards in order to define intelligent solutions for issues confronting the function.  
**Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Sustainability**  
•    Comply with relevant HSE policies, procedures & controls and applicable legislation and sustainability guidelines in line with international standards, best practices and ADNOC Code of Practices.  
**Reports**  
•    Provide inputs to prepare Section MIS and progress reports for Company Management.

  
  
  
Generic Accountabilities (continue)   
  
Internal Communications & Working Relationships   

•    Regular Contacts with operational level management within all auditable departments throughout ADNOC.  
•    Frequent contacts within ADNOC at all levels of Management u

jobs.title: 2027 Financial Analyst Intern

Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.  
Are you willing to dive deep to develop those solutions and deliver results? At Amazon, we move with purpose and speed, and this requires us to work with a dynamic network of retail, HR, marketing, tech and operations partners. We help others understand finance and are trusted business advisors. We employ every facet of data and communication to ensure our partners and our leaders have the most up to date and reliable information to help them make the best possible decision.

We are looking for finance Interns to work alongside, and support managers gaining a deep insight into the financial systems, processes, and controls used to record Amazon’s growing volume of daily, weekly, and monthly transactions.  
You will learn how Finance supports the various business teams in forecasting and analyzing actual financial results, managing the external reporting of Amazon’s quarterly financial statements and inputting to the launch of new customer-focused initiatives to ensure customers can find and discover anything and everything they want online.  
Available to commence an internship in Q2 2027. You should be available for 3 to 6 months, full time (40h/week).

As an intern, you will be matched to a mentor. In addition to learning about an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

- Competitive pay  
- Impactful project and internship/role deliverables  
- Networking opportunities with fellow interns  
- Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.  
- Mentorship and career development  
If you're successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies  
Internship length is 3 to 6 months, full-time.  
- Currently enrolled in or will receive a Bachelor's or Master's Degree with a graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028  
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English  
- Available to commence an internship between January and December 2027. Yes, our start dates are flexible! You should then be available for 3-6 months, full time (40h/week).  
- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Income Auditor, Holiday Inn & Staybridge Suites Dubai Business Bay
jobs.description:
**INCOME AUDITOR**

  

**ABOUT US**

  

Travel is a journey. At Holiday Inn, we help make it a joy.

  

Starting with a warm, inviting welcome for all guests, whether traveling on business or for fun, enjoying a quick night, or relaxing for the week. We thrive on making our guests stays brighter, helping them create memories that will last a lifetime. Irresistible smiles are our specialty. We should know, we’ve been on our journey since 1952. So, if you can help us spread the joy of travel to all, we’d love to give you a warm welcome to the Holiday Inn® family.

  

The Holiday Inn & Staybridge Suites Dubai Business Bay, a cluster of hotels, is looking for an experienced **Income Auditor** to join their extraordinary team!  
Conveniently located in the heart of Dubai’s Business Bay area, home of the Burj Khalifa! Minutes away from The Dubai mall, renowned Jumeirah Beach, and with convenient access to all of Dubai’s world leading tourist attractions. The Holiday Inn & Staybridge Suites Dubai Business Bay will include 280 hotel rooms as well as 120 one- and two-bedroom apartments, convenient F&B offerings & meeting and events facilities.

  

**YOUR DAY TO DAY**

  

As Income Auditor, your main responsibilities will be to review the work of the Food & Beverage department and Night Audit ensuring accuracy of the information as reported. Properly allocate revenues and posts to the appropriate ledger accounts. Review and verify the accuracy of revenues reported to Accounts Receivable by balancing the accounts to appropriate ledgers on a daily and monthly basis. Provide assistance in the closing of books at month end and preparation of necessary reports as required by the Hotel and directed by the Director of Finance.

  

**WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU**

  

It is not just about completing tasks and doing the work! We are looking for personality, originality, creativity, focus and a passion to deliver great results directly and via the whole team!

  

Bachelor in Finance or degree in vocational hospitality, 3-5 years’ experience in 4-5 star Hotel, or equivalent combination of education and Finance operations experience. Strong leadership abilities and a drive to excel.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

  

We'll reward all your hard work with competitive salary and benefits.

  

Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve - visit www.careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.

  

Go on - show us how your passion and personality are the perfect fit to deliver memorable experiences to our guests.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - FP&A and Corporate Finance | Al-Futtaim Automotive | Dubai
jobs.description:
Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.

  

By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

  

**Overview of the Role**

  

We are currently hiring a **Senior Financial Analyst – FP&A & Corporate Finance** to join a dynamic and fast-paced business environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded finance professional who thrives on transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive business performance. The role will play a key part in business planning, financial forecasting, performance analysis, investment evaluation, and strategic decision-making across multiple business streams.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead the annual budgeting process, quarterly forecasts, and long-term strategic planning.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models to support business decision-making.
* Prepare monthly management reports, financial commentary, and variance analysis.
* Analyze revenue, margins, pricing, costs, and profitability trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Monitor operating expenses and support cost optimization initiatives.
* Deliver insightful performance reporting and business reviews for senior leadership.
* Evaluate capital expenditure projects and business investments using NPV, IRR, payback, and sensitivity analysis.
* Support cash flow forecasting, working capital management, and capital efficiency initiatives.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to challenge assumptions, improve performance, and drive business growth.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of financial planning and reporting processes.

**Required Skills to Be Successful**

  

* Strong expertise in FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.
* Advanced financial modeling, scenario planning, and sensitivity analysis skills.
* Proven capability in variance, profitability, margin, and cost analysis.
* Experience with investment appraisal and business case development.
* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate data into commercial insights.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP, planning, and BI platforms.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**About the Team**

  

You will be joining a high-performing finance team that partners closely with business leaders to drive financial performance and strategic growth. The team plays a critical role in planning, forecasting, performance management, investment analysis, and delivering insights that support key business decisions. The environment encourages collaboration, continuous improvement, commercial thinking, and professional development.

  

**What Equips You for the Role**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* Professional qualification such as CA, CPA, CFA, ACCA, CMA, or MBA in Finance, or active progression towards one.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience within FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, or related finance functions.
* Proven experience in business planning, forecasting, performance analysis, cost management, and cash flow forecasting.
* Experience in asset-intensive, distribution, retail, automotive, or similar sectors is advantageous.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to influence business stakeholders and challenge constructively.
* High attention to detail, integrity, accountability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

We’re here to provide excellent service but a little help from you can ensure a five-star candidate experience from start to finish.

  

Before you click “apply”: Please read the job description carefully to ensure you can confidently demonstrate why this opportunity is right for you and take the time to put together a well-crafted and personalised CV to further boost your visibility. Our global Talent Acquisition team members are all assigned to specific businesses to ensure that we make the best matches between talent and opportunities. We not only consider the requisite compatibility of skills and behaviours, but also how candidates align with our Values of Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence.

  

As part of our candidate experience promise, we also want to make ourselves available to you throughout the application process. We make every effort to review and respond to every application.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

jobs.title: Aviation Regulatory Compliance Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

  

Ensures regulatory compliance across aviation safety and environmental systems by monitoring adherence to local and international aviation regulations, supporting internal audits, validating corrective actions, and contributing to the continuous improvement of safety and environmental performance within the sector.

  

**Key Responsibilities/Duties**

  

1.**Monitor regulatory compliance** with local and international aviation safety and environmental standards, ensuring alignment with ICAO, GCAA, and DCAA requirements.

  

2.**Support internal audit programs** by coordinating audit schedules, reviewing evidence, tracking findings, and verifying closure of corrective actions within required timelines.

  

3.**Review and assess safety management system (SMS) documentation**, including safety reports, risk assessments, and change management submissions to ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks.

  

4.**Analyse operational and environmental data** to identify compliance gaps, trends, and risks, and prepare periodic reports for sector leadership.

  

5.**Coordinate with internal units and external stakeholders** to ensure consistent implementation of regulatory requirements and promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.

  

6.**Maintain an integrated compliance database** to support decision‑making, reporting, and regulatory oversight activities.

  

7.**Support the preparation of the annual integrated safety and environmental quality report**, including compliance performance, audit results, and risk levels.

  

8.**Assist in developing and updating policies, procedures, and work instructions** related to regulatory compliance and quality assurance.

  

9.**Monitor implementation of change**‑**management plans** and assess their impact on safety systems to ensure alignment with regulatory expectations.

  

10.**Provide technical input** on regulatory updates, compliance risks, and improvement opportunities to enhance the sector’s safety and environmental performance.

  

11.**Other Duties:** Performs other job-related duties as assigned by the Office Manager or Executive Director.

  

**Academic Qualifications:**

  

·Bachelor’s degree inAviation Management, Aerospace Engineering, Safety Management, Environmental Science, or a related field is an advantage.

  

·Master’s degree or higher qualification in Aviation Management, or a related discipline is an additional advantage.

  

**Certifications:**

  

·ICAO Safety Management (SMS) certification preferred.

  

·ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 auditor certification is an advantage.

  

·Aviation regulatory compliance or auditing certifications are desirable.

  

**Professional Experience:**

  

·Minimum 8+ years of relevant professional experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 6+ years of relevant professional experience with a Master’s degree, in aviation safety, regulatory compliance, quality assurance, or a closely related field.

  

·Practical exposure to Safety Management Systems (SMS), audit protocols, and aviation regulatory compliance frameworks within a controlled or regulated environment is preferred.

  

·Experience operating within government or statutory regulatory bodies, demonstrating familiarity with public sector governance, accountability, and compliance standards, is an advantage.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

  

To perform accounting tasks of Finance Operations: Bank transactions, Bank Reconciliation Statements, Maintaining Petty cash, ePayment support, Etisalat payments and extend support to functions of Accounts Payable, Receivable, General Ledger, Fixed Assets and Budgeting.

  

**Key Responsibilities/Duties**

  

**1.****Record and Maintain DCAA Accounts**

  

Recording, Updating, attaching, and matching of various documents such as Purchase/Sale Invoices, Delivery notes of Goods and Services, Purchase Orders, Customers Report – Direct Issue Voucher etc; and record the transaction in the GRP Accounts Payable/Receivable system. Extract and provide information to Finance Analyst for reporting and cash management to ensure accuracy of all the transactions recorded.

  

**2.****Processing Payments**

  

Review of DCAA Accounts Payable/Receivables. Payables - supplier’s statements, priority payments and proceed with preparation of payment vouchers for payments dues and facilitate the workflow of verification and approval. Receivables - Follow-up for collection due before deadlines, tracking of cash and cheque deposits, bank transfers and matching receipts against the relevant invoices and collection of payments.

  

**3.****Bank Reconciliation Statements**

  

Review bank transactions in DCAA bank statement of accounts and DCAA GRP Books and preparation of monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements and ensure matching of records. Prepare collections/payments reports and issues raised to Financial Analyst or Specialist.

  

**4.****Monthly Reporting**

  

Prepare and review monthly reports of revenue Collection & invoice payments, prepare acknowledgement reports, extracting and scrutinizing reports related to closing activities of GRP accounting modules, Transfer of data from Accounts Receivable/Payable to General Ledger and closing periods.

  

**5.****Filing & Documentation**

  

Filing of the copies of payment/receipt vouchers, bank documents, collection reports, bank transfer advice and other collection related documents in proper files and to ensure accessible to management and auditors any time.

  

**6.****Other Duties**

  

Perform any job-related activities of Accounts Payable, General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Budgeting etc; as requested by the Head of Section.

·Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance or related field preferred.

  

****Certifications:****

  

·GRP FINANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets and General Ledger).

  

****Professional Experience:****

  

·Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in financial management, accounting, budgeting, and financial reporting with a Diploma degree; or fresh graduate with a Bachelor’s degree, or fresh graduate with a Master’s degree.

jobs.title: Group Research & Innovation Manager
jobs.description:
**We’re Hiring: Group Research & Innovation Manager | Raibal Holding | Fujairah, UAE**

Raibal Holding is recruiting a permanent
**Group Research & Innovation Manager**
to run the Group’s research portfolio across a diversified farming platform, beginning with marine and agricultural research and extending across apiculture and livestock operations as the portfolio grows.

This is not a laboratory-based role. You will be the person who keeps the Group’s research organised, evidenced and moving: coordinating decisions on what to test, continue or stop, and making sure results reach the right destination, whether that is internal use on our farms, research services, commercial transfer or public benefit.

You will work alongside scientists, who retain authority over research methods, integrity and laboratory safety, and with Raibal’s business sponsors, who approve spending, contracts and formal acceptance.

**What you’ll do**

* **Control commitments:**
  oversee active research, agreements and deliverables, with a clear owner, due date and acceptance status for each
* **Maintain reliable evidence:**
  track sources, versions, results and gaps so every claim on priority work is backed by a source, test result or stated assumption
* **Plan capacity and cover:**
  coordinate people, facilities and specialist support, ensuring critical activities have named cover and documented dependencies
* **Prepare decisions:**
  run portfolio reviews, set priorities and bring complete proposals to decision or escalation promptly, with clear options, costs and uncertainties
* **Manage partners and adoption:**
  coordinate approved partnerships with universities, research institutes and technology providers, and ensure every pilot has a sponsor, baseline and measure before launch
* Report portfolio progress to senior management and route successful results into operational use

**What we’re looking for**

* Degree in science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience
* Proven leadership of at least two applied research or innovation programmes, including at least one with a measured pilot or adoption result
* Background in marine science, aquaculture, agriculture, food or environmental research is strongly preferred
* Experience coordinating research partners and operating teams to deliver measurable results
* Track record of making and escalating well-reasoned recommendations, with responsibility for budgets
* Excellent written English and clear, structured communication

**Why join Raibal Holding**

A rare opportunity to build and run a Group-wide research portfolio within one of the region’s growing agriculture and farming platforms, where your work translates directly into operational improvements across multiple businesses.

**30 November 2026**
